name: skill-marketplace
description: Claude Code plugin marketplace for engineering work, organised by the life of a change. product decides what to build; architecture shapes the system with DDD, module design, ADRs, contracts and Blueprint diagrams; dev builds the change through a planned pipeline; verify reviews it by reading and proves it by running; security audits it; ops ships and runs it. Foundations used at every stage: code for understanding an existing codebase, craft for engineering principles, stack for library references, agentic for agents, skills and AGENTS.md instruction files, and herdr for multi-agent fleets. Domains: design for UX/UI with measured gates, game for game design and a cited review board, godot for building in Godot, ml for model training, and work for knowledge work and prose. Vendored skills are supply-chain-controlled copies, each credited in its plugin's NOTICE.md.

plugins.name: product
plugins.description: What should we build, and why? From idea to buildable spec. Discover: product-brainstorming, adhd (parallel divergent ideation), office-hours, prfaq, scientific-problem-selection. Research: deep-research, litreview, deepread, synthesize-research. Challenge: interview-me, grilling (with docs-anchored and design-brief modes), devil, roast, plan-ceo-review, advanced-elicitation. Specify: spec (with a quick PRD mode), requirement-convergence, documentation-criteria, code-to-prd. Hands off to dev:brainstorm for a technical design or architecture:ddd for a new system. Vendored skills are credited in NOTICE.md.

plugins.name: architecture
plugins.description: How should the system be shaped? ddd runs the nine-step DDD Starter Modelling Process (understand, discover, decompose, strategize, connect, organise, define, code, contracts) over one ddd/ workspace with validators, a review page and recorded decisions, advised by the ddd-decision-strategist agent; domain-modeling is the light mode for an existing codebase. Module design: codebase-design, improve-codebase-architecture, improve, architect. Decisions: architecture-decision-records. Contracts: contract-first, api-design-principles, saga-orchestration. Diagrams: Blueprint renders validated architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow and lifecycle diagrams as explorable HTML; drawio writes editable .drawio files. The DDD and Blueprint tools require Node.js 18 or newer. Vendored skills are credited in NOTICE.md.

plugins.name: dev
plugins.description: Build the change. A chained pipeline over one ai_docs/ workspace: brainstorm a design, analyze it from eight perspectives, break it into SLC phases, write a zero-context plan, pre-flight it, execute it in batches with reviewer subagents, a swarm or an arena of parallel candidates, check the implementation against the plan, and hand off. Discipline along the way: tdd, debug (with a hard-bug and performance-regression mode), verification-before-completion, doubt-driven-development, unlazy (with a lite mode), show-me-your-work. Finish the change: git worktrees, advanced git, finishing-a-development-branch, make-pr-easy-to-review, change-description, spec-driven-workflow. Adapted in part from obra/superpowers, HumanLayer, wshobson/agents, BMAD-METHOD and pstack; see NOTICE.md.

plugins.name: verify
plugins.description: Is it right, and does it work? Review by reading: code-sweep runs twelve parallel reviewers (or a light six-aspect pass) with the code-reviewer agent; lenses for AI debt, complexity (14 metrics on TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Rust and GDScript), blast radius, API design and Python anti-patterns; code-review-excellence and receiving-code-review for both sides of a review. Prove by running: verify-feature, verify-this, santa-method, human-gate and benchmark-checklist; a project-local verification skill; harnesses for CLI, browser, iOS Simulator and Windows desktop; test suites with e2e-harness, Playwright, React Testing Library, Bats and k6, and test-audit to prune them; exploratory dogfood, adversarial UX, click-path and web-quality audits. Vendored skills are credited in NOTICE.md.

plugins.name: security
plugins.description: Is it safe? security-sweep is the entry point: a multi-agent OWASP, STRIDE, secrets, supply-chain and LLM-security audit of the repository with a verifier fan-out and a CSO report. To go deeper on one area, use security-threat-model, security-and-hardening or security-best-practices. For agent code: agent-security-hardening, mcp-dependency-review and skill-security-auditor. Guardrails for Claude Code: block-no-verify-hook and git-guardrails-claude-code, which install hooks only when invoked. Vendored skills are credited in NOTICE.md.

plugins.name: ops
plugins.description: Ship it and run it. ship-gate audits a codebase before production against a pre-launch checklist and calls security:security-sweep for its security section. Instrument code (structured logs, RED metrics, OpenTelemetry, alerts with runbooks); define SLOs with burn-rate alerts; run feature flags as a lifecycle; design chaos experiments; plan zero-downtime migrations; design CI/CD and GitHub Actions; Docker, Kubernetes and Terraform patterns; dependency and Dependabot triage; changelogs from Conventional Commits; blameless postmortems; and wizards for steps only a human can do. Vendored skills are credited in NOTICE.md.

plugins.name: code
plugins.description: What does this existing code do? core primes a repository once with a deterministic zero-token knowledge graph via graphify (or a quick read-only mode) and hands instruction files to agentic:keys. research-codebase and trace document code as it is, with the codebase-locator, codebase-analyzer and codebase-pattern-finder agents; why answers design-rationale questions from every source it can reach. deepwiki generates and maintains wiki docs with line-level citations and validated Mermaid diagrams, including brownfield documentation for agents. code-tour writes CodeTour walkthroughs. explain-diff turns a diff, branch or PR into a self-contained HTML explainer with a quiz and architecture:blueprint diagrams, and narrates itself when a local text-to-speech service is available. explain-diff is adapted from Geoffrey Litt's explain-diff gist; see NOTICE.md.

plugins.name: craft
plugins.description: What does good code look like? Sixteen one-page engineering principles from Lauren Tan's pstack (type-system discipline, model the domain, minimize reader load, boundary discipline, idempotent operations, build the lever, test behavior not implementation, subtract before you add and more), plus code-level practice: karpathy-coder and ponytail for the smallest correct change, error-handling-patterns, performance-optimization, deprecation-and-migration, source-driven-development, constraint-driven-development, ai-development-guide, prototype for a throwaway answer to one design question, and oh-my-issues for clustering an issue backlog by root cause. Vendored skills are credited in NOTICE.md.

plugins.name: stack
plugins.description: What does this library get wrong? Library and framework references with the gotchas a model gets wrong: GreenSock's official GSAP set; a motion/react system in three layers; Remotion; Vercel's React and Next.js performance rules, Next.js Server Components and Server Actions, and the React docs' discipline for useEffect; shadcn/ui; TypeScript best practices; Postgres and Prisma; database migrations per tool; C++ Core Guidelines and Boost.Asio; .NET backend patterns; Swift concurrency. Vendored skills are credited in NOTICE.md.

plugins.name: agentic
plugins.description: Make agents, skills and the agent harness. Instruction files: keys installs a self-maintaining AGENTS.md hierarchy and folds CLAUDE.md and other agent-instruction files into it; writing-for-agents, llm-friendly-context, rules-from-code and engineering-rules. Learn from sessions: agent-memory, stow, retro, correct. Route and behave: model-router, persona. Build agents: loop-design-check, agent-architecture-audit, autoresearch-agent, cli-for-agents. Make skills and servers: skill-creator, mcp-builder, harvest and book-to-skill. agent-memory can install hooks, only when invoked. skill-creator and mcp-builder are owned copies of Apache-2.0 skills from anthropics/skills; vendored skills are credited in NOTICE.md.

plugins.name: herdr
plugins.description: Run a herdr multi-agent worker fleet. herdr-orchestrator decomposes the work, spawns and assigns workers by tier, answers blocked workers and integrates results through the horch CLI. herdr-worker is the other side of that protocol. herdr-atomic wraps the herdr terminal workspace manager in deterministic scripts. herdr-setup checks the machine (herdr CLI, horch on PATH, agent integrations) and fills only the gaps. Requires the herdr CLI (herdr.dev), which is not bundled.

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: How should it look and feel? A design-system spine with the design-critic agent: house rules (design-doctrine), DTCG design tokens in three tiers, brand kits, a token build, governance, migration to or from external design systems, Figma sync and DESIGN.md; component, screen and dashboard design with any-framework code generation, image-to-code, redesign and fidelity prototypes; UX writing. Directions against generated-looking UI: frontend-design, impeccable, hallmark, ui-ux-pro-max, Emil Kowalski's design engineering and 138 named design systems. Gates that measure instead of claim: contrast, states, axe, keyboard, target size, overflow, reduced motion and responsive behaviour in light and dark; WCAG 2.2 audits, screen-reader testing and Core Web Vitals. Critique with a Rams lens, design review and plan-design-review. Adapted from plugin87/ux-ui-agent-skills (MIT) and vendored skills; see NOTICE.md.

plugins.name: game
plugins.description: What game, and is it good? Any engine. A design studio: game-ideation, fun-targeting, core-loop, systems-economy, progression-content, level-ux, art-direction, game-brief, prototype-plan, design-diagrams, and one-page-game-design for a one-page visual design as interactive HTML or standalone SVG with a printable PDF, collaborative or headless. A review board backed by cited rules distilled from 38 game-development books: game-studio-cpo as the entry point, and auditors for systems, balance and economy, code architecture, performance, and QA and ship-readiness.

plugins.name: godot
plugins.description: Build it in Godot. Thirteen skills mined from the agent sessions of one long Godot build: bot balance loops and measure tables, a scripted balance model as the source of game data, upgrade-tree design with bot policies and human playtests, feature seams and save migrations, headless Godot runs without side effects, a headless GDScript test loop, frame-cost measurement, rendered-frame visual verification, palette-locked pixel art, procedural audio, release builds and store pages, safe refactors, and habits for a worker fleet on one game. The rules each skill measures against live in the game plugin's auditors.

plugins.name: ml
plugins.description: Post-train a model end to end, eval-gated. finetuning-method-selection decides whether to fine-tune at all (RAG and prompting off-ramps first) and routes by data shape to SFT, DPO/ORPO/KTO, GRPO/RLVR or continued pretraining, with a memory-math worksheet and a dated base-model catalog. eval-harness-first builds the golden set, one binary grader per failure bucket, judge calibration and the base-model baseline before any training config is written. dataset-curation formats, templates, packs and documents the training data with a synthetic-data collapse guard and a dataset card. lora-qlora-recipes gives the all-linear, alpha-equals-2r LoRA/QLoRA recipe with Unsloth defaults, the TRL mapping and failure signatures. preference-optimization picks and configures DPO, ORPO, KTO or SimPO and constructs the pairs. grpo-rlvr-training sets up GRPO with verifiable rewards, the mandatory reward-inspection gate and variant selection by failure mode. checkpoint-promotion gates a trained checkpoint on data hygiene, a drift budget, a paired arena and a canary before it ships. Alongside: rag-architect designs and evaluates RAG pipelines with a corpus-driven chunking optimizer, a requirements-to-design planner and a precision/recall/NDCG retrieval evaluator; recsys-pipeline-architect designs Source-Hydrator-Filter-Scorer-Selector-SideEffect ranking pipelines for any top-K problem. Contains third-party skills under their own licenses — see NOTICE.md.

plugins.name: work
plugins.description: Knowledge work and prose. Data: profile a dataset, QA an analysis before it ships, SQL across warehouse dialects, statistics and A/B tests with stdlib calculators, Python charts and an offline HTML dashboard. Product operations: metrics reviews, roadmap and stakeholder updates, competitive briefs, market sizing, startup metrics, variance analysis. Support and legal: ticket triage, customer escalations, contract review and NDA triage. Writing: technical-writing as the entry, with clear-prose and writing-guideline checks, humanize, READMEs and questionnaires. Media and files: HTML slide decks, ffmpeg video editing, file conversion, spaced-repetition Mochi decks and a grounded Markdown knowledge vault. Vendored skills are credited in NOTICE.md.
